name: Spatial access, export and topology
description: Represent which compartment, membrane face or local site target/material can access and which export, topology or targeting feature enables the encounter.
claim_scope: A target/material/partner location relation; export, orientation, local concentration, assembly and bulk fractionation remain separate.
distinctions: Cellular presence versus access to required face.
Processed substrate versus native assembly compatibility.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: Fractionation does not prove integral topology.
Heterologous membrane topology is not automatically native.
Processing is not assembly; absent expression is not an assembly-specific negative.
boundary: This is spatial opportunity. A01/A03 specify operation/mode, A06 system role, and A09 whether localization is required at the tested expression level.

evidence.source_locator: Main Results and Figs. 1–3; outer- versus inner-membrane access controls.
evidence.observation: MurJ inhibition restricts periplasmic ColM access; only inner-membrane disruption restores cleavage of accumulated labeled material.
evidence.limit: In-vivo access evidence; no purified transport/raw replication.

evidence.observation: Tat export, N-terminal septal targeting and catalytic-region rescue are separable; an induced nonseptal exported construct rescues chaining.
evidence.limit: Induced rescue does not establish native targeting dispensability; degraded AmiB-GFP is not reliable localization.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Relevant phylogeny/localization, cell-cycle and temperature Results plus lipid methods; no new localization assay or claim that all RND homologs have this substrate.
evidence.observation: HpnN loss retains whole-cell hopanoids but removes outer-membrane allocation, separating bulk abundance from spatial opportunity.
evidence.limit: No purified-protein transport mechanism was demonstrated.

evidence.source_locator: Trace O2006; complete relevant topology Results/Methods/Discussion and captions.
evidence.observation: Controlled cysteine accessibility favors cytoplasmic access near PibD catalytic residues over a conflicting five-segment prediction.
evidence.limit: Heterologous bacterial membranes, partial blocking and burial/leakage limit native archaeal orientation claims.

evidence.source_locator: Trace O2013; Figures 2–3 and 8–9; main Results.
evidence.observation: PilA1 hydrophobic-domain hybrid remains expressed/processed but lacks pili and adhesion, separating cleavage from assembly compatibility.
evidence.limit: PilA3 hybrid lacks expression, so is not assembly-specific negative; other filament components remain possible.
